name: Lakewood Center
description: Lakewood Center is a major regional shopping destination in Los Angeles County, featuring over 200 stores and dining options across two levels. Anchored by prominent department stores including Macy's, JCPenney, Target, and Forever 21, the enclosed mall offers a comprehensive retail experience with national brands, specialty shops, and a diverse food court serving the Lakewood community since 1952.
demographics: Serves the diverse communities of Lakewood, Long Beach, and surrounding areas in Los Angeles County with a mix of middle-income families and young professionals.
summary: A historic regional mall in Lakewood featuring over 200 stores with major department store anchors serving Los Angeles County since 1952.
